evidence.method: Fetch originals, feed exact staging _Meta, evaluate _date(meta.published) or _date(" ".join(meta.text)[:5000]); all four yielded None. Isolated parser reproduction, not complete Daily execution.
evidence.cause: Publisher timestamps exist in cXenseParse metadata and JSON-LD, while _Meta does not consume those dates; header/script text precedes article body in the 5000-character fallback.
evidence.date_provenance_caveat: Visible publication date and JSON-LD/meta timestamps are distinct evidence. For Ricarte Soto, visible 2026-10-08 conflicts with metadata 2026-10-07T22:54:15Z; preserve both and explicitly resolve provenance. Do not silently substitute crawl or modification date.

distribution.counts_note: Counts use event_date, not crawl date; history is not equivalent to public feed. Health published is last-run; queue states are cumulative. Discovered values cannot be divided by last-run published to infer coverage.

editorial_unresolved.staleness_behavior: Default 14-day filter excludes old special; 30/60/90-day views can still label it weekly. Generic period filtering is not an explicit weekly freshness policy.
editorial_unresolved.bupa_tense_mismatch: See preserved first report. Existing history/feed presence must not be mistaken for faithful event lifecycle.
editorial_unresolved.health_false_positives: Broad media prefilter accepts synthetic non-health real-estate/banking investment phrases. This is a prefilter weakness, not proof of an observed downstream non-health publication. Editorial gate and actual records require separate evaluation.

External 403/502 can be environment-specific. They block independent verification, not proof of universal source outage or genuine news absence.
Builder states media implementation is done but validation remains pending; this audit rejects readiness evidence, not an invented claim of formal closure.
Seen ledgers store fingerprints; exact-URL absence in queue/history/feed does not establish unseen state without reconstructing the source-specific fingerprint. No missing seen state is manufactured.
History and feed legitimately differ through curation/grouping; no automatic omission claim from different row totals.
